nodes.title: 大床

widgets_values: A young woman wearing long stockings, a black short skirt, and high heels sat alone on a park bench, with slender legs and a sweet smile towards the camera. The moonlight shone through the leaves on her slightly curly long hair, and the streetlights cast a little light on the stone road. The gentle breeze at night brushed over her silhouette gazing at the lake, creating a peaceful atmosphere with a faint sense of loneliness.,
